Punjab Congress Meeting Sees Disruption by Former CM Channi's Supporters

During a Punjab Congress meeting in Patiala attended by AICC in-charge Bhupesh Baghel, supporters of former Chief Minister Charanjit Singh Channi disrupted proceedings. The supporters chanted slogans in favour of Channi and against party leader Raja Warring. Responding to the indiscipline, Bhupesh Baghel stated that those engaging in such behaviour would be expelled from the party.
